messages.snippet: Sarah, Further to our call, the board has agreed to take advice on a claim against Ferncliffe Alloys
messages.subject: Possible claim against Ferncliffe Alloys
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Further to our call, the board has agreed to take advice on a claim against Ferncliffe Alloys over the stainless bar that turned out not to be 316L. David Okoro has the technical history and the Wraysbury report; Andrew can speak to the commercial loss, particularly the Wexbourne contract we lost.

Can you let me have an engagement letter and a view on next steps? We would like to move reasonably quickly.

Best regards
Patricia Vaughan
General Counsel & Company Secretary, Calverton Industries Limited

messages.snippet: Patricia, Thank you. I am pleased to act. I attach our engagement letter for CALV-0140; please sign
messages.subject: RE: Possible claim against Ferncliffe Alloys
messages.plaintextBody:
Patricia,

Thank you. I am pleased to act. I attach our engagement letter for CALV-0140; please sign and return at your convenience. Tom Gallagher will run the matter day to day and will be in touch to collect the contract, the purchase orders, the mill certificates and the Wraysbury report.

On timing, I suggest we send a letter before action once we have the documents in order. We can then assess merits and quantum.

Kind regards

Sarah Whitfield
Partner
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
